name: French Chicken Fricassée with Creamy Mushroom-Spinach Sauce & Rice (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp butter, unsalted
1 tsp thyme, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour over  the veggies and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.
Add broth and cream to the skillet, then stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and continue to cook until thickened, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
½ cup heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside a small handful for serving.
When the sauce has thickened, add remaining parsley and spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the greens to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.

Divide rice, sauce, and chicken between containers, then sprinkle with reserved parsley. Set aside to cool completely, about 15 minutes. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Reheat in an oven or microwave and enjoy!
